title: Mixing: Goodnight Tonight by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

A mixing session for Wings’ ‘Goodnight Tonight’ single took place on 9 February 1979.

None of the day’s mixes were released, however, and ‘Goodnight Tonight’ was mixed again on 2 March 1979.

Page last updated: 30 January 2026

  • 1967: Recording: Fixing A Hole
  • 1964: The Beatles’ first Ed Sullivan Show

  • 1961: The Beatles live: their first Cavern Club show
